ARC: Epilogue ()

=== EPISODE 71: Three Realms (태초) [flashback]
Epilogue · Part II. The annual meeting is a small 정자: four posts, a raised floor, clouds for a yard. Living, dead, and western rows all fit if nobody stretches.
[diagram pantheon]
Before the principals sit — servants first. The Three Realms under the Big Man Upstairs still gossip like any court.
haemosu: Ah, Kangrim…. Looking as young as ever, eh?
kangrim: Shut it, sun. We aren't supposed to talk right now.
haemosu: Hey, hey… still pissed off about the thing? / It's been hundreds of years at this point.
yumla: H-hey, Samsin.
samsin: Oh, long time no see, Yumla! How's the Underworld these days?
yumla: Y-you know… full of dead people. (awkwardly)
haewonmek: Your Honour. Your face went purple for a second. / I won't put it in the ledger.
Then the midwife and the sun find the same rail. The rest of the pavilion develops a sudden, devout interest in clouds.
samsin: Hey, Haemosu. / Did you see Yumla’s face? Went straight purple. / And I barely hiked the skirt.
haemosu: Barely? I felt that from the chariot. / They’re talking ledgers — and only the two of us look alive.
samsin: I’ll be honest. / After a birth… my hands get restless. / The husbands go red in the face, and my thighs remember first. / You?
haemosu: The shallows, for me. / Someone waist-deep in water — the wheels stop themselves. / They still freak out that I came down once. I still miss that heat. / Anyone in this pavilion hungrier than us? Name one.
samsin: Ibiga? He flirts with weather. / Kangrim stares at his notebook. Yumla goes purple if I breathe. / We’re the only ones actually hot in here. / Man or not — I like that I can gossip like this with you.
haemosu: Obviously. Heat doesn’t have a gender. / When mortals pant — you and I hear that sound first. / Polite tea faces… leave that to the others.
kangrim: …Nothing for the ledger. / And that’s correct.
ibiga: Haemosu. About to brag about climbing off the chariot again? / In the middle of gossiping with Samsin.
haemosu: Only once. / That is the whole of it. / Not bragging… reporting.
Then the principals duck the lintel — Hallakgungi alone, Big Star with his dark court, Little Star with sky and sun and birth.
The 정자 was not built for three sovereignties. They sit anyway.
sara: Hey Little Star… didn't the Big Man Upstairs send his son to the mortal domain a while back? / What happened to him? (joking) You didn't crucify him, did you?
sobyeol: Speaking of which… / Big things are happening in the mortal realm. / The mortals are starting to speak of reunifying Dangun's kingdom.
daebyeol: …
sara: Elder brother of the dead goes quiet again. / In my field, resurrection and ruin grow in the same rows. Reunification probably does too.
kangrim: Sir.
sara: Yes?
kangrim: I've always been curious… what sorts of flowers grow in your fields?
sara: Haha… well, there are those that regenerate new blood, grow new skin, grow new bones… / To be honest, I can't even keep track of all of them anymore. (laughs) / Why do you ask?
kangrim: I was just curious… using all of these flowers at once… / Is it… is it possible to resurrect a dead person?
sara: (face hardens, becomes serious) / Grim Reaper Kangrim. What is this line of questioning? / Do you have something you need to tell me?
kangrim: No, sir. I was—
sara: Well, to answer your question. It is possible. / I've done it… only for one person. / But I do not get involved in mortal affairs.
sobyeol: I cheated for the living world. / Them cutting each other… that is my small law too. / Still — when they call Dangun’s name again, does the Big Man Upstairs laugh, or sigh?
daebyeol: Let the meeting begin. / Business of the living… last item on the agenda.
The minutes of that meeting never leave Heaven’s table. Down below, five thousand men are counting fifty thousand…!
